about: The states a page passes through. Four parts run side by side: the page itself, the hunt (idle or hint), each flap, and the bursts. engine/toddler-bots.mjs watches the real engine while the bots play and fails on any rule below that it sees broken; check.py makes sure every rule here has a check there and no check is left without a rule.

states.showing: one page is up and takes taps
states.turning: the moment between two pages: Next, Back, a choice, Home

moves: tap Next, Back or a choice, or hold Home

states.hint: the critters still hidden nudge and their icons glow

moves: the age's hintMs with no tap on the picture, a critter still hidden
the age's hintMs more with no tap, a critter still hidden

states.shut: the flap covers who is behind it

states.burst: a starburst word is up (FOUND YOU!, PEEKABOO!, 3 PIGS!)

moves: something on this page was found, lifted, counted to the end or tapped for its sound word

rules.hint-on-time: a hint comes exactly hintMs after the last tap on the picture (or the last hint), and only while a critter is still hidden
rules.hint-ends: a hint glows for hintShowMs, then the hunt is idle again
rules.burst-ends: a burst is gone within burstMs x the age's pace
rules.flap-toggles: each tap on a flap moves it to the other state
rules.turn-resets: a turn lands on a new page that is idle, with every flap shut, no burst and no counting badges
rules.turn-leaves-nothing: nothing the last page started (a burst, a fanfare, a peekaboo, a hint) shows up or sounds on the new page
